q: Should a Cilegon steel exporter rely on CBAM default values?
title: Cilegon steel: actual data or defaults
short: Only as a stopgap. Default values published by the Commission include a mark-up, so they usually come out higher than a well-measured plant. An importer buying Cilegon steel pays certificates on whichever figure it declares, so verified actual emissions from your installation are what keep its cost down.
audience: Integrated and downstream steel producers in the Cilegon industrial area of Banten, Indonesia, and their EU importers

p: Default values are set by the Commission per good and production route for use when actual data is missing. In the definitive period they carry a mark-up, which is the point: they are meant to be cautious.

ul: A monitoring approach for the installation.
Fuel, reductant and electricity records for the reporting period.
Verification by an accredited verifier before the importer uses the figure.

p: Share defaults for the first shipments if you must.
Move the importer to verified actual figures as soon as they exist.
